get.summary: Returns liveness status of the backend process.
Returns readiness status once initialization is complete.
Returns typed system status for the frontend walking skeleton.

post.summary: Triggers a refresh cycle across all registered data sources and returns the resulting status.

get.summary: Returns the saved workspace list and any nonfatal configuration warning.

post.summary: Creates and persists a new workspace configuration.

delete.summary: Removes all workspace configuration and returns to the empty startup state.

put.summary: Updates and persists an existing workspace configuration.

delete.summary: Permanently deletes a workspace assignment from configuration.

post.summary: Archives a workspace so it no longer appears as an active tab (isEnabled = false).
Restores a previously archived workspace (isEnabled = true).

put.summary: Persists a new tab order for the currently active (enabled) workspaces.

get.summary: Returns the current user preferences and any nonfatal configuration warning.

put.summary: Validates and persists updated user preferences.

get.summary: Returns the projected MPS dashboard for a workspace, auto-loading from QAD on first access.

post.summary: Forces one reload of MPS source facts from QAD for the workspace and returns the projected dashboard.

get.summary: Returns the full workspace Open Orders report for the supplied current MPS snapshot.

post.summary: Refreshes the workspace Open Orders report against the supplied current MPS snapshot.
Exports selected rows and visible columns from a matching cached workspace report; never validates QXtend changes.
Freshly validates changed workspace lines and prepares applicable QXtend CSV files for human review.

get.summary: Returns the workspace Planning Workbook for the supplied current MPS snapshot and horizon, reusing compatible cached source facts.

post.summary: Reacquires Open Orders, inventory, prices and forecast (not MPS) for the supplied current MPS snapshot.

get.summary: Reports whether a saved Planning draft file exists for the workspace (file existence only).
Reads the saved Planning draft and compares each saved baseline with the workspace's currently loaded MPS snapshot.

put.summary: Saves signed Planning adjustments with their loaded MPS baselines. Does not apply anything to QAD.

delete.summary: Deletes the saved Planning draft file. In-memory proposals are not affected.

post.summary: Validates every staged adjustment against the complete loaded MPS snapshot and returns the QAD Mass Updater CSV (Part, signed adjustment, Monday date; no header). Any invalid entry rejects the whole export. Nothing is applied to QAD.

get.summary: Returns current inventory for the supplied loaded MPS scope, reusing a compatible process-local snapshot.

post.summary: Reacquires Finished Goods detail and MAX prices only; never refreshes MPS or Open Orders.

get.summary: Returns lazily-loaded Part Info for a workspace's selected MPS parent part.
Returns the parent-scoped four-week Work Order planning window (Due-Date-based Falldown plus Week 0-3 under the active Due/Release basis), optionally narrowed to one bucket.
Returns lazily-loaded material/kitting lines and Kitting Summary for one work order.
Returns the Stage 9 immediate material analysis for one work order.
Returns Stage 9 immediate-material summary indicators for the parent-scoped four-week planning window.
Returns the complete Stage 7R planning-window population for a manufactured component authorized through the Work Order drill-down.
Returns the scheduler-visible current-effective BOM for a workspace's selected MPS parent part, enriched with shared Site + Part inventory.
Returns lazily-loaded Component Detail (master, selected-site planning, Standard Cost, QCTC, shared Site + Part inventory) for a workspace-selected component part.
Acquires all physical inventory rows for the selected component and workspace site.
Returns the lazily-loaded Approved Vendor List (AVL) for a workspace-selected component part.
Returns the active workspace's component-grouped conventional open PO lines for its MPS snapshot's BOM-derived component scope.
